mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (shop_id, user_id, order_no, is_deleted, pay_amount, pay_type, order_status, remark, consignee, phone, region, detail_address, shipping_type, courier, created_at) VALUES (#{shopId}, #{userId}, #{orderNo}, 0, #{payAmount}, #{payType}, #{orderStatus}, #{remark}, #{consignee}, #{phone}, #{region}, #{detailAddress}, #{shippingType}, #{courier}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, shop_id, user_id, order_no, is_deleted, pay_amount, pay_type, order_status, remark, consignee, phone, region, detail_address, shipping_type, courier, tracking_number, sign_status, created_at, pay_at, ship_at, confirm_at, finish_at, updated_at FROM orders WHERE id = #{id} AND shop_id = #{shopId} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT id, shop_id, user_id, order_no, is_deleted, pay_amount, pay_type, order_status, remark, consignee, phone, region, detail_address, shipping_type, courier, tracking_number, sign_status, created_at, pay_at, ship_at, confirm_at, finish_at, updated_at FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND shop_id = #{shopId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET is_deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND shop_id = #{shopId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, shop_id, user_id, order_no, is_deleted, pay_amount, pay_type, order_status, remark, consignee, phone, region, detail_address, shipping_type, courier, tracking_number, sign_status, created_at, pay_at, ship_at, confirm_at, finish_at, updated_at FROM orders WHERE order_status = #{status} AND is_deleted = 0 AND created_at <= #{threshold}
